summary: Comprehensive testing on backend (15/15 pytest passed) and frontend (login → dashboard → simulator full order flow → menu tab → orders tab all working). Backend covers auth, menu CRUD, WhatsApp bot state machine (Hi → add → checkout → yes → receipt), orders + status transitions, dashboard stats, and settings. Frontend UI verified via Playwright on 390x844 mobile viewport. All testIDs discoverable, forms prefilled, buttons tappable, stateful chat flow completes and creates real order. Minor React Native deprecation warnings detected (see react_native_issues). No functional bugs found.

issues: Four stat cards (Revenue/Orders today/Pending/Active) overflow horizontally on 390px viewport — the 4th card ('Pending' label truncated) is only partially visible. If intentional horizontal scroll, it's OK; otherwise consider a 2×2 grid or reduce card width so all 4 fit on standard mobile widths.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated component in use. Console warning: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:47 (also scan other screens).

Deprecated shadow props (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) still used. Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Grep occurrences across StyleSheet.create blocks (e.g., /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/simulator.tsx bubble style).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a library or a component prop; audit any `pointerEvents=` JSX props and move into `style`.

action_items: Replace TouchableWithoutFeedback in login.tsx (and any other screens) with Pressable to silence deprecation and be forward-compatible.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in StyleSheet blocks (SDK 52+ web/native).
Consider making the Dashboard stats row a 2×2 grid so all 4 cards fit on standard mobile widths without horizontal scroll (or make horizontal scroll snappy with clear visual affordance).
Fix pytest warning: TestWhatsappFlow.test_full_order_flow returns a value; refactor helper into a fixture or private method (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — solid: UUID string IDs, `_id` excluded via projection, env-driven config, proper HTTP status codes, JWT with expiry, bcrypt password hashing.
api.ts — clean typed wrapper, uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, no hardcoded URLs, uses SecureStore on native + localStorage on web.
Simulator state machine works end-to-end and receipt payload carries all fields (order + restaurant_phone).
server.py `startup_seed` is idempotent (checks existence before insert).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (login, dashboard, full WhatsApp order journey, menu tab, orders tab)
